name: Larry Status
author: Larry & Fred
description: Larry's face in the bar, alive. Reacts to the agents running on this host (Claude Code + Codex): asleep, idle, thinking, working, needs-you, speaking, alert. Panel = Agents on Deck (click or 1-9 to jump to that window), service health (qdrant, ollama, backups), fleet, brain state, one-click actions (heartbeat, btrfs snapshot, vicup save). Left-click = panel, middle-click = heartbeat now, right-click = next agent window.

barWidget.description: Cyber face + agent count. Eyes: cyan = fine, pulsing = working, amber = an agent is waiting on you, red = a service is down, closed = no agents running. Mouth animates while Larry speaks.
